stories.summary: 'Violence, dispossession, and destruction': Israeli forces and settlers launch 467 West Bank attacks in one week Israeli forces and settlers launched at least 467 attacks on Palestinian communities across the occupied West Bank over the past week, the Palestinian prime minister’s office said. In a post on X, the office said the violence damaged 75 Palestinian homes and other structures. It described the attacks as part of a “relentless escalation of violence, dispossession, and destruction”.
